# AirAware

> Air-quality (AQI) forecasts for any street in Pune and Mumbai, India, up to seven days ahead, built from 37 CPCB monitoring stations, live weather and the Copernicus CAMS particle forecast.

Forecasts are estimates, not the official CPCB AQI and not medical advice. Each comes with a likely range and the chance of a Poor day.

## Pages
- [Today](/): city forecast, today hour by hour, any area on the map
- [Insights](/explore): when in the day the air is cleanest, the Diwali effect, the year in air
- [Science](/science): how the model works and how accurate it is
- [Track record](/track-record): every published forecast scored against reality
- [Privacy Notice](/privacy) and [Terms](/terms)

## API (JSON, no key needed for public data)
- [OpenAPI docs](/api/docs)
- `GET /api/overview?city=Pune|Mumbai`: today, the week ahead, weather now
- `GET /api/area?lat=..&lon=..`: forecast for any point in either city (rate-limited)
- `GET /api/search?q=..&city=..`: find an area by name
